svg.desc: Read left to right: seven teaching layers, the four real-world layers, and what each layer wraps around your data
svg.text: OSI and TCP/IP: one stack, two vocabularies
Read left to right: seven teaching layers, the four real-world layers, and what each layer wraps around your data
HTTP · FTP · DNS · SSH — what apps speak
Mnemonic 7→1: All People Seem To Need Data Processing. Switch = L2 · Router = L3 · TCP/UDP = L4 · HTTP = L7.
Each layer only talks to the same layer on the other side — headers are added going down, stripped going up.
